about: The training range by Ovda (modern-iaf/docs/training-plan.md §1, data-formats.md §5.2): the air-to-ground and threat lessons' one range. Compiled by iaf-sim missions into ranges.json; a mission names it with "range".

notes.area: open desert 15 to 30 km north of Ovda, 20 km inside the border: the range's real name and place are not published (searched 28 Nov 2026); the training centre by Ovda has live-fire ranges with ground targets and SAM threats (key-aero, second-hand)
notes.circle: a T-72 hulk as the bull, the score rings round it (not drawn): real ranges score a bomb by its distance from the bull
notes.strafe: a row of four truck hulks across the run-in from the east, standing in for strafe panels
notes.sites: the sim's own S-300, Tor-M1 and ZSU-23-4 sites stand in for the range's threat emitters (Blue Flag 2021 simulated the SA-2, SA-3, SA-6, SA-8 and the Pantsir, bf21, second-hand)
notes.control: no IAF range control's callsign or frequency is published: the callsign is the plain word, the frequency invented like the notebook's

footnotes.key-aero: Key.aero, Knights of the Negev, quoted by a search engine (the site refuses automated access; second-hand), https://www.key.aero/article/knights-negev
footnotes.bf21: Janes, Wide range of SAMs simulated during exercise Blue Flag in Israel (2021), quoted by a search engine (paywalled; second-hand), https://www.janes.com/defence-news/wide-range-of-sams-simulated-during-exercise-blue-flag-in-israel/
